questions.stem: What is the role of checkpoints in the cell cycle?

options.text: They produce the spindle fibres needed for mitosis
They check that each stage has been completed correctly before the cell moves on to the next stage
They break down the nuclear membrane
They speed up the rate of cell division

questions.explanation: Checkpoints are control mechanisms that verify important conditions have been met, such as whether DNA has been accurately replicated, before the cell proceeds to the next phase. This prevents errors from being passed to daughter cells.
